WITH current_period AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM("total"), 0) AS total_revenue
  FROM "public"."invoice"
  WHERE "billing_country" = 'USA'
    AND "invoice_date" >= '2024-01-01'
    AND "invoice_date" < '2025-01-01'
),
base_period AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM("total"), 0) AS total_revenue
  FROM "public"."invoice"
  WHERE "billing_country" = 'USA'
    AND "invoice_date" >= '2023-01-01'
    AND "invoice_date" < '2024-01-01'
)
SELECT
  c.total_revenue AS current_revenue,
  b.total_revenue AS base_revenue,
  CASE
    WHEN b.total_revenue = 0 THEN NULL
    ELSE (c.total_revenue - b.total_revenue) / b.total_revenue
  END AS yoy_growth_rate
FROM current_period c
CROSS JOIN base_period b;
output_summary.explanation: 按发票账单国家统计USA的发票总额同比增长率。使用invoice表的total列（发票总额），分别计算2024年和2023年（基期）的USA账单国家发票收入总和，再计算同比增长率；基期为零时返回NULL以避免无限增长。
